Plus a $10 reservation fee per booking, and each vehicle needs a provincial park vehicle permit ($9.50 a day, $16.50 for three days, $44.50 a year). Manitoba Parks' booking site (July 2027 nights) and 2026 fees, read 2026-10-12.
